findings.claim: One-shot action authority is not explicitly bound to an exact server primitive and intent-specific target-eligibility predicate.
findings.minimalChange: Freeze an exact primitive, intent/policy hash, trusted-parameter hash and deterministic semantic target predicate per action slot, and bind the slot spec through every authority and receipt artifact.

findings.claim: Frame freshness and UI identity can lapse after the last mandatory check but before raw I/O.
findings.minimalChange: Bind a monotonic dispatch deadline and UI generation into tx#2/consumption evidence and run an immediate TCB-side pre-I/O guard.

findings.claim: Provider qualification and canary authority are not locked to the target app/device UI environment.
findings.minimalChange: Add a private target-environment attestation and qualification set, bind their hashes into locks and action evidence, and reject runtime drift.

findings.claim: The zero persistent/public side-effect requirement lacks an operational boundary and independent oracle.
findings.minimalChange: Freeze per-family effect boundaries, independent pre/post sources and reset obligations; unresolved or unobservable state must follow an owner-selected policy rather than UI inference.
